originalRequirement.ears: WHEN an action needs user attention or a notification changes, the shell SHALL publish concise identity-correlated accessible status without moving focus, deduplicate repeated receipts and apply the frozen notification announcement/interruption policy.
originalRequirement.verification: Named native, keyboard and assistive-technology fixtures where applicable; independent observed results, exact identities, source hashes and frozen product-policy oracle.
originalRequirement.legacyEvidence: docs/elm-roadmap/INTERACTION.md; new coverage: final UI/UX review
